name: Title Reel
summary: A 15-second kinetic type intro for a small studio that plays like a video and lands on a real page
about: A studio home page that opens with a short film made of big moving type: letters drop in, a word rolls like a slot machine, giant rows slide across, counters tick up, colour wipes sweep by and a kite draws itself before the name assembles. It ends on a live hero with a flying kite, followed by work, services and contact sections. Good for a freelancer or studio home page, a portfolio opening or a launch teaser.
how: The intro plays on its own; paper kites drift behind it and the scene shifts with your pointer.
Use the player bar to pause, replay, drag the timeline to any moment, or skip straight to the page.
With focus on the page, Space or K toggles play and the arrow keys jump a second.
After the intro the hero stays as the real header, and the sections below fade up as you scroll.
With reduced motion every scene still plays, but as gentle crossfades without movement.
